trial_court: Family Court, Dehradun, O.S. No.774 of 2017
facts_of_case: Wife's application for expenses pendente lite under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 was dismissed by the Family Court. Wife claimed Rs.25,000/- as litigation expenses. Husband was already giving monthly maintenance and bearing education expenses of their child.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking expenses pendente lite to establish that such expenses were incurred.
legal_principles.held: Apart from this, the entire education expenses of the child, who is studying in Brightland School at Dehradun as well as kitchen, water charges are also borne by the respondent/husband, though both the appellant and respondent are residing in the same house.

legal_principles.principle: The court may increase the amount awarded towards litigation expenses if it is not sufficient.
legal_principles.held: We are of the opinion that Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) as awarded by the court below towards litigation expenses will not be sufficient, and therefore, we increase the amount...

outcome.final_order: Husband directed to give further amount of Rs.25,000/- to wife within a week. Family Court directed to proceed with the matter expeditiously.
